blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Transport group Manibela branded US President Donald Trump the “king of wars” and “king of oil price hikes” on Tuesday, Nov. 17, blaming his administration’s role in armed conflicts for driving up fuel prices in the Philippines. Manibela president Mar Valbuena made the remarks as the group staged a demonstration against Trump’s expected arrival
